hypothesis: With m2 fixed at 0.5 on data_seed 0, N=128 force has a lower ceiling than N=64; it is not just slower to converge. Trained to 12000 steps, N=128 seeds 22-23 stay at least 0.04 below the same seed's N=64 3000-step trained force R2 (0.767 / 0.770). Values are read from probes_final at the best-margin layer, unrounded, and the layer is reported. Within-run values are read as that layer's control plus margin, never from the max-over-layers trajectory field. Horizon check: step-6000 trained force R2 must be within 0.03 of the 6000-step N=128 runs (0.681 / 0.696); otherwise the result is reported as horizon-confounded.
expected_if_true: Final trained force R2 <= 0.727 (seed 22) and <= 0.730 (seed 23), and force gains <= 0.03 from step 6000 to 12000 in both seeds. accel_step normalised margin in [0.60, 0.85].
expected_if_false: Final trained force R2 >= 0.75 in at least one seed with gain >= 0.04 from step 6000 to 12000, consistent with slower convergence. A split between seeds counts as inconclusive.
